data.headline: Infrastructure Manager -CTO @ Medtronic - Given Imaging | Cyber-security, Recovery Planning
data.about:
As Infrastructure Manager - CTO at Medtronic - Given Imaging, a global leader in medical devices, I bring over two decades of experience in IT management and strategic leadership. My focus is on delivering IT vision and solutions to drive business growth by connecting cloud, compute, storage, networking, and collaboration needs with organizational goals. Holding a CISO credential from Technion - Israel Institute of Technology, I specialize in cyber-security, proactive monitoring, and recovery planning.  

At Medtronic, I oversee IT infrastructure and applications for the entire business unit, managing processes, technologies, budgets, and daily operations. This includes implementing business continuity plans, disaster recovery strategies, and global data security policies that meet international standards like ISO 27001 and PCI. Through a collaborative and innovative approach, I ensure IT systems empower the business to achieve its objectives effectively and securely.

description.text:
Global publicly traded medical devices company 
Providing IT vision and solutions to grow the business is my top priority.
Connecting the business needs for cloud, compute, store, connectivity, collaboration, and networking.
Job Description: To manage IT infrastructure and applications for the entire BU. Overall responsibility for s/w, h/w, service, and applications. Manage teams of professionals within geography and beyond. Project Management for the business as well as for Global IT organization. 
Own process, technologies, budget and daily operations.
Responsible for BCP (business continuity plan) as well for the DR site.
Manage and coordinate data security and privacy requirements toward regulator and corporate. 
Member of the Management Team.

To plan, implement and establish a mixed Data Center that will provide state-of-the-art computing services for the internal (traditional like R@D, Finance, Marketing) IT as well as for the various WW Fortune500 customers.
Implementing mixed DC with AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Rackspace. 
Manage Information systems like: Priority, SaleForce.com, Clarizen
Manage, implement and maintain source code management systems like Microsoft TFS, SVN.
Plan and implement security policies that assure compatibility with various international standards like ISO 27001, PCI and several health industry security standards.

To plan, direct, manage and oversees the activities and operations of the IT Department: administer the IT budget, staff, and physical facilities of the department.
Overall responsibility for the technology, architecture and availability of the decentralized systems, software and hardware in the company.
Change management, consulting to Information Systems projects starting from their initiation and until the production stage.
Initiate, determine and innovatively lead the technological and applicative policy in accordance with the company strategy.
Determine the work methodology, standards and policies (ITIL standards) - Implement ServiceDesk.
Duties and Responsibilities: Develop Information Technology Strategy in support of the company’s mission and core objectives.
Direct, control, and motivate the staff of the IT department.
Develop and annual business plan and operating budget for the department and monitor the implementation of these to ensure the financial and operating targets are met.
Negotiate SLA with both internal and external customers and service providers and monitor service delivery to ensure the agreed targets and standards are met.
Accountable for the management, mentoring and career development of all IT staff.
Oversees the management of corporate help desk activities and resolves escalated issues if necessary.
Defines and seeks approval for the level of IT resources required to meet these goals and priorities and schedule major projects.
Direct the preparation and implementation of policies, procedures and standards relation to information and telecommunication systems.
Responsible for researching and evaluating new technologies.
Direct attend and participate in staff meetings and related activities; attend workshops to keep up to date with all IT issues
Heading the MIS department with overall responsibilities for infrastructure, data security as well as IS systems likes ERP and CRM systems.

Director, Information Technology (Worldwide), a position involving management of the IT department on a worldwide basis – 15 offices: HQ in Israel, HQ in Santa Clara, and 13 branches and subsidiaries (Europe, Americas and Asia)
Responsibilities:
•	Defining information requirements, initiating and integrating global information systems for data warehouse, information flow and sharing
•	Total responsibility for the establishment, maintenance and operation of a global information system including 15 offices-including management of individuals and teams around the world. During this period, I have personally managed the establishment of 7 new branches and subsidiaries from scratch (!)
•	Plan, prepare and administer the IT worldwide budget for all IT functions. 
•	Management of systems architecture, characterization and procurement
•	Establishment of the corporate Intranet, Extranet and VPN
•	Introduction of the ERP system to the corporate MIS environment
•	Planning and leading projects and implementation supervision (Application Service Providers: RighTrack for professional services organization; Servicewise for CRM).

In heading the MIS dept. I have been solely responsible for:
•	Establishment and maintenance of the company’s communications infrastructure, from its start-up phase, through its IPO and on to a quick growth period (including the establishment of the LAN and WAN (leased lines, microwave links, satellite VSAT networks and optical fibers).
•	Designing and implementing Data Security policies as well as implementing securities procedures
•	Administration and implementation of all IT programs (including MS Office, finance/logistics(Oracle Application, MFG Pro), Exchange5.5, Checkpoint Firewall1, customer service and billing).
•	Establishment of a 24x7 help desk service (internal & external)
•	Management of systems architecture, characterization and procurement
•	Supervision of IT professional teams and individuals
•	Manage the Year 2000 program; accountable for risk management, remediation actions and contingency planning.

Responsible for the application and implementation of various projects at the following customer sites:
•	Telrad: Established an S.M.S. site.
•	Hewlett Packard Customer Support Dept: Support and integration of computer application and peripheral equipment into data networks.
